title: The Student Pitch Where Klarna's Founders Came Last of Three
conflicts: Year of the contest: Resultat and Quartr say 2005, EFN says 2004; story says '2004 or 2005'. Jury membership differs between Sequoia, Resultat and EFN; story names only Stefan Persson and a Wallenberg, on Siemiatkowski's account. Walerud's stake: 600,000 kronor (her own words via EFN) versus $60,000 (Sequoia); story uses the kronor figure.
notes: Told on the founders' own account as instructed (Sequoia 2023 profile; Resultat 2014 interview).
